blurb:
Language: English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Experience the wonders of aviation and space exploration with our hassle-free transportation service to the Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum’s Udvar-Hazy Center in Chantilly, VA.

Service Details:

Departure: 10:00 AM – Pick-up from your location in Washington, DC.
Enjoy 2.5 hours of exploration at the Udvar-Hazy Center.
Return: 2:00 PM – Drop-off back in Washington, DC.
Total Duration: 4 hours

 Important Notes:

This is a transportation-only service; a museum guide is not included.
The Udvar-Hazy Center offers free admission.
They offer free guided tours for groups by reservation. You can reserve a tour guide with them directly.
If the wheelchair/stroller is collapsible, we can put it inside the trunk.
